verdict.rationale: Running evals in CI and gating deployments is a fair question for an LLM observability platform, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows real-time scoring of production responses via webhooks, Playground testing, and prompt versioning with rollback. These are adjacent features: nothing documents a CI integration, eval runs against datasets in a pipeline, or pass/fail gating of deployments.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run evals in CI and gate deployments on their results
